canonical_data: service-managed sessions, uploaded and connected files, execution state, and generated work artifacts
current_repo_note: Cowork now shares a Claude home with Chat, but Anthropic documents it as a distinct delegated-work mode with the agentic architecture of Claude Code and an isolated remote execution environment.
strengths: Purpose-built delegation flow for multi-step work rather than a sequence of chat prompts
Isolated cloud execution and explicit tool permissions create a clearer operational boundary
Persistent files and sessions support long-running knowledge-work projects across devices
weaknesses: Proprietary provider-native service with no self-hosted execution path
Available tools, limits, and retention controls vary by plan and continue to evolve
Remote execution and connected data require careful review of permissions and generated actions
why_it_matters: Establishes delegated general knowledge work as a product boundary distinct from both conversational Claude and developer-facing Claude Code.
